name: h5p
description: Interactive H5P content for your agent: multiple choice, true/false, fill in the blanks, drag the words, cards, question sets and course presentations, built as content-only .h5p packages on your computer, checked before they're written, through h5p-mcp.

description.es: Contenido interactivo H5P para tu agente: opción múltiple, verdadero o falso, rellenar huecos, arrastrar palabras, tarjetas, conjuntos de preguntas y presentaciones, como paquetes .h5p solo con el contenido, en tu ordenador y comprobados antes de escribirlos, a través de h5p-mcp.

en.label: Interactive H5P content
en.description: Questions, gap texts, cards, question sets and slides as .h5p packages ready to upload, checked first and in your language, with a preview to review them.

es.label: Contenido interactivo H5P
es.description: Preguntas, textos con huecos, tarjetas, conjuntos de preguntas y diapositivas como paquetes .h5p listos para subir, comprobados antes y en tu idioma, con una vista previa para revisarlos.

agent-kit.help: Interactive H5P content through h5p-mcp: I build content-only .h5p packages (multiple choice, true/false, fill in the blanks, drag the words, Dialog Cards, Flashcards, Question Set, Course Presentation) on this computer, checked before they're written and in the content's language, with a preview, and read existing ones; my h5p:h5p-packages skill holds how. I upload nothing: in Moodle, moodle-teacher does, and a package plays only where the site has its content type installed.
